_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take for this tiny app (tiny DB, no external integration); alarm = hard ceiling. A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently. Longer reasoning per row lives in that doc.

server-tests.why: the test task alone: ~800 tests on 4 vCPU; leaves 2 min of the 5 min job target (and 2 of the 10 min alarm) for setup, compile, detekt and Kover

server.why: compile + detekt + tests + Kover on 4 vCPU; a tiny DB should not need more than 5 min

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: resolve lockfiles + one trivy run on a few thousand lines of lockfile

web.why: npm ci (cached) + lint + knip + vitest + vite build of a small SPA

e2e-static.why: npm ci (cached) + eslint + knip + tsc over a handful of specs

images.why: multi-stage docker build: gradle installDist + vite build, layer cache cold on a runner; since the buildx layer cache and the Trivy image scan landed this is re-measured, not assumed (build-times.md)

k8s-static.why: one checkout + a kubeconform download + validation of ~11 small objects, twice (raw and rendered)

e2e.why: PROVISIONAL (nightly): images build + compose up + Playwright over a tiny stack; revisit with the first real data

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: npm ci of the e2e workspace with the npm cache

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: install-deps (apt) with the browser cached; ~60 s on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: PROVISIONAL: compose build of the app image with the BuildKit layer cache (measured locally: 2m08s cold, 1m32s with a warm cache and one changed source file); the Gradle installDist layer is uncached whenever a source file changes

e2e/Start the stack.why: PROVISIONAL: postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under `up --wait`; the app's healthcheck start_period is 30 s

e2e/Run E2E.why: PROVISIONAL: the Playwright specs alone against a running stack (4 workers); local e2e-playwright target is 300 s on 18 cores, revisit with the first split runs

server-build.why: ./gradlew cleanTest build on 18 cores: compile, detekt, all tests, Kover, alignment

server-test.why: ./gradlew :server:test - ~800 tests against one shared Postgres container

web-gates.why: lint:api + check:api + lint + knip + test:coverage + build

e2e-playwright.why: PROVISIONAL: blackbox suite against a running compose stack; revisit with the first real data
